intent_test_split.description: processed/intent_test.csv.gz — the held-out split of the training data build (Banking77 + CLINC150 + SNIPS + TWCS weak labels)

emotion_test_split.description: processed/emotion_test.csv.gz — GoEmotions single-label (official train+dev+test pooled, deduplicated, re-split), mapped to 6 emotions. The neutral downsampling rule (<= 2x the largest other class) did not trigger in this build: 16,021 neutral vs a cap of 31,388 (2 x 15,694 happy), so this split already has the natural single-label distribution.

emotion_goemotions_natural_test.description: GoEmotions OFFICIAL test.tsv, single-label examples only, mapped to 6 emotions with emotion_map.json, neutral NOT downsampled (natural distribution). Texts also present in our emotion train/val split were removed (the training build pooled GoEmotions train/dev/test before re-splitting).
